user.title: Connect to akenza
user.description: Create an API key in akenza (Organization settings → API keys) with read access to workspaces, assets, device types and device data, then paste it here.

data_description.api_key: Secret of an organization-level akenza API key.
data_description.base_url: Only change this for private or regional akenza deployments.

workspaces.title: Select devices
workspaces.description: {organization} has {workspace_count} accessible workspace(s). Choose which devices to import into Home Assistant.

data.enable_hidden_kpis: Include data keys hidden from KPIs

data_description.workspace_ids: Devices from these workspaces are imported.
data_description.tag_ids: Optional: only import devices that carry at least one of these tags.
data_description.default_topic_only: Skip lifecycle, configuration and other secondary topics.
data_description.enable_hidden_kpis: Create entities for data keys the device type marks as hidden (created disabled otherwise).
data_description.device_images: Add an image entity per device showing the product picture of its akenza device type.

reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {organization} is no longer valid. Enter a new key for the same organization.

reconfigure.description: Replace the API key or API URL for {organization}.
